quotes.text: 2 The Lord shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.

Our bodies are all important to us, though they may be old and
withered, emaciated with toil, pain, and sickness, and our limbs bent
with rheumatism, all uniting to hasten dissolution, for death is sown
in our mortal bodies. The food and drink we partake of are contaminated
with the seeds of death,

“ You are going to be destroyed ,” say they, “ destruction awaits this City! ” Well! What if we are? We are as able to be destroyed as any people living. What care we whether we are destroyed or not?
